🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, mixed/rotation breadth; rising fear, falling stocks-versus-bonds, and falling credit ratio provide independent confirmation. VXX (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +34.27%) is ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT ratio (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -8.99%) is ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear increasing: VXX (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +34.27%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ratio at 0.7337 (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.45%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; cyclical-versus-defensive ratio (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -0.32%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tightening risk tone, with some rate support: TLT (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +1.17%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND, while the yield-curve ratio (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.44%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. Dollar proxy UUP (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +1.65%) ↓ falling over 1W, CORRECTION.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive relative resilience: XLP (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +5.91%) and XLU (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.77%) are ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.78%) is BELOW TREND. Tech/Financials ratio (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -18.98%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; relative style favors Value over Growth, though breadth remains mixed at 5/11.

5. US vs Global?
US equity weakness persists: SPY (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -6.88%) is BELOW TREND. India shows relative strength through INDA (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +13.82%), ABOVE TREND, while EEM (1W: -2.56% | 1M: -9.79%) and FXI (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -3.69%) are BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -20.55%) and IBIT (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -25.45%) are BELOW TREND. Small caps also lag: IWM (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -4.04%) is BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity weakness: CPER (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -18.83%) and GLD (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -12.04%) are BELOW TREND. Agricultural relative strength is firmer, with the agri-versus-market ratio (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +4.70%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -10.72%) is BELOW TREND, while BNO (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -14.74%) is in RECOVERY. UNG (1W: -2.92% | 1M: +6.85%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed downside in core risk assets: SPY (1W: -1.85% | 1M: -6.88%) and XLK (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.78%) are BELOW TREND, alongside rising VXX (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +34.27%), ABOVE TREND. Major divergence across the core ETFs is absent; the notable rotation is relative weakness in XLK versus Financials, as the Tech/Financials ratio (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -18.98%) is BELOW TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive resilience and selective relative strength; reduce exposure to weak growth and speculative areas. XLP (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +5.91%) is ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.78%) and ARKK (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -20.55%) are BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves beyond 5/11, monitor XBI (1W: +7.97% | 1M: +1.14%), ABOVE TREND, for continued relative strength.
BEARISH: If fear remains elevated, watch XLK (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.78%), BELOW TREND, for further weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the recent rebound extends, monitor BNO (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -14.74%), in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If industrial demand signals weaken further, watch CPER (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -18.83%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 24.33 (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +34.27%), ABOVE TREND, and HYG/LQD at 0.7337 (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.45%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Watch the SPY/TLT ratio at 8.7147 (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -8.99%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, and Tech/Financials ratio at 2.7569 (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -18.98%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive and mixed participation. Defensive ETFs XLP (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +5.91%) and XLU (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.77%) show relative resilience, while the Tech/Financials ratio is BELOW TREND. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +14.23% | 1M: +34.27%), ABOVE TREND, and falling credit health in HYG/LQD (1W: -1.17% | 1M: -1.45%), BELOW TREND.
